name: Mental Maths Under Pressure
description: Push mental arithmetic to interview speed against a clock.

lessonObjectives.l1-towards-fifty: Find which operation costs you the most time and drill it.
lessonObjectives.l2-two-by-two: Multiply two-digit numbers in your head by cross multiplication.
lessonObjectives.l3-big-division: Divide by a two-digit number in your head.
lessonObjectives.l4-decimals-fast: Multiply and divide decimals by moving the point.
lessonObjectives.l5-which-fraction: Compare fractions quickly by cross multiplication.
lessonObjectives.l6-percent-of-percent: Combine percentage changes in your head.
lessonObjectives.l7-estimating-products: Estimate a product to within 5% in a few seconds.
lessonObjectives.l8-square-roots: Estimate a square root to one decimal place.
lessonObjectives.l9-eighty-in-eight: Practise the 80-in-8 format and pace yourself through it.
lessonObjectives.l10-next-in-sequence: Find a sequence’s rule under time pressure.
lessonObjectives.l11-word-problems: Turn short word problems into arithmetic quickly.
lessonObjectives.l12-mock-test: Sit a full timed test and review every error.
lessonObjectives.l13-negative-marking: Decide when to answer, guess or skip when a wrong answer costs a point.
lessonObjectives.l14-ranking-likelihoods: Rank three events by probability within seconds, using benchmarks rather than exact sums.
lessonObjectives.l15-probability-at-speed: Answer short probability questions at about two minutes each, without a calculator.
lessonObjectives.l16-harder-sequences: Find the rule in interleaved, two-step and digit-based sequences.
lessonObjectives.l17-full-battery: Sit arithmetic, sequences and probability sections in a row at test pace.
